results.overview: Navy SEAL Commander James Reece turns to vengeance as he investigates the mysterious forces behind the murder of his entire platoon. Free from the military's command structure, Reece applies the lessons he's learned from nearly two decades of warfare to hunt down the people responsible.

results.name: The Tattooist of Auschwitz
results.overview: The powerful real-life story of Lali Sokolov, a Jewish prisoner who was tasked with tattooing ID numbers on prisoners' arms in the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp during World War II.

results.name: Generation Kill
results.overview: The first 40 days of the war in Iraq as seen through the eyes of an elite group of U.S. Marines who spearheaded the invasion along with an embedded Rolling Stone reporter. A vivid account of the soldiers and of the forces that guided them in an often-improvised initiative.

results.name: A Spy Among Friends
results.overview: Follow the defection of notorious British intelligence officer and KGB double agent, Kim Philby, through the lens of his complex relationship with MI6 colleague and close friend, Nicholas Elliott.

results.name: The Man in the High Castle
results.original_name: The Man in the High Castle
results.overview: Explore what it would be like if the Allied Powers had lost WWII, and Japan and Germany ruled the United States. Based on Philip K. Dick's award-winning novel.

results.name: SAS Rogue Heroes
results.overview: The dramatised account of how the world’s greatest Special Forces unit, the SAS, was formed under extraordinary circumstances in the darkest days of World War Two.

results.name: Shōgun
results.overview: In Japan in the year 1600, at the dawn of a century-defining civil war, Lord Yoshii Toranaga is fighting for his life as his enemies on the Council of Regents unite against him, when a mysterious European ship is found marooned in a nearby fishing village.

results.name: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
results.original_name: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
results.overview: Dorrigo Evans, an Australian surgeon on the Burma Railway during WWII, is haunted by his time as a POW, as well as a forbidden affair he had with his uncle's wife prior to the war.

results.name: Tour of Duty
results.overview: The trials of a U.S. Army platoon serving in the field during the Vietnam War.

results.name: X Company
results.overview: An emotionally-driven character drama, set in the thrilling and dangerous world of WWII espionage and covert operations. It follows the stories of five highly skilled young recruits - Canadian, American and British - torn from their ordinary lives to train as agents in an ultra-secret facility on the shores of Lake Ontario. These agents parachute behind enemy lines, where they're fair game for torture and execution. From elegant hotels to hellholes in the field, it's one risky operation after another, masterminded by the brains of Camp X.

results.name: The Unit
results.overview: A covert team of special forces operatives risk their lives on undercover missions around the globe, while their wives maintain the homefront, protecting their husbands' secrets.

episodes.name: Premiere in Normandy
episodes.overview: An HBO Entertainment News piece about the premiere of the mini-series in Normandy for Easy Company vets, their families, friends and stars of the series.

episodes.name: Who's Who: The Men of Easy Company
episodes.overview: Video biographies of the characters.

episodes.name: The Making of "Band of Brothers"
episodes.overview: Interviews made of the various actors and cast members that provide the knowledge and production skills and sets required to make the film a success.

episodes.name: We Stand Alone Together: The Men of Easy Company
episodes.overview: This companion documentary to HBO's acclaimed World War II miniseries “Band of Brothers” tells the story of Easy Company through recent interviews with some of the actual veterans. Combined with the words and memories of the former soldiers is rare and archival film footage and photos that bring to vivid life their incredible achievements.

episodes.name: Ron Livingston's Video Diaries
episodes.overview: Ron Livingston (Lewis Nixon) shot a 12 part video diary during the making of “Band of Brothers”.

episodes.name: He Has Seen War
episodes.overview: The surviving veterans and family members of Easy Company and the 1st Marine Division -- whose stories are shown in "Band of Brothers" and "The Pacific" -- discuss reintegrating into civilian life and the impacts the war had on them.

episodes.name: Currahee
episodes.overview: Easy Company is introduced to Captain Sobel, who has the group undergo hard and unfair training. As a result, Sobel comes into conflict with his men, including Richard Winters, his executive officer. The company is shipped to England to prepare for D-Day.

episodes.name: Day of Days
episodes.overview: Easy Company lands in Normandy, scattered all across and away from their drop zone. 1st Lt. Meehan, commander of Easy, is killed when his plane suffers a direct hit and 1st Lt. Winters must take command and 1st Lt. Speirs is introduced.

episodes.name: Carentan
episodes.overview: Easy Company are sent to liberate the French village of Carentan, where they lose several men in heavy fighting. The episode focuses on Private Albert Blithe, who struggles with crippling anxiety following the battle.

episodes.name: Replacements
episodes.overview: With the addition of many new men, Easy Company heads to Holland to participate in Operation Market Garden and prepare an Allied route into Germany, but they meet stiff German resistance.

episodes.name: Crossroads
episodes.overview: Winters writes a report on the challenge of an unexpected resistance to a German attack, and is haunted by his conscience after shooting a teenage German soldier. Operation Pegasus is depicted. Easy Company is called to Bastogne to repel the sudden German counterattack.

episodes.name: Bastogne
episodes.overview: Easy Company experiences the Battle of the Bulge and have to hold ground near Bastogne while running low on ammunition and other supplies. The episode focuses on medic Eugene "Doc" Roe as he helps out his fellow soldiers where he can, while also scrounging for medical supplies, of which the Company is dangerously low.

episodes.name: The Breaking Point
episodes.overview: Easy Company battles near Foy, Belgium, losing numerous men. In the episode, the actions of 1st Lt. Norman Dike, the Company's commander, are examined and questioned. Serving as narrator is 1st Sgt. Carwood Lipton, who attempts to keep the morale of the men up as they endure their trials in the forest near Foy.

episodes.name: The Last Patrol
episodes.overview: Easy Company is in Hagenau in Feburary, 1945, where they prepare for a night patrol mission to capture German prisoners. The patrol includes one veteran who is despised for missing Bastogne and a new lieutenant fresh out of West Point.

episodes.name: Why We Fight
episodes.overview: As the Allies move into Germany and the war comes closer to an end, disillusionment and anger set in for Easy Company--until they stumble onto a concentration camp abandoned by the German military.

episodes.name: Points
episodes.overview: As the Germans surrender, it appears that that the hard days for Easy Company are over as they are stationed in Austria. But they soon learn that those solders without enough service points will be sent to fight in Japan.

items.title: My Hero Academia
items.overview: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.

metadata.name: My Hero Academia
metadata.overview: Izuku has dreamt of being a hero all his life—a lofty goal for anyone, but especially challenging for a kid with no superpowers. That’s right, in a world where eighty percent of the population has some kind of super-powered "quirk," Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that’s not enough to stop him from enrolling in one of the world’s most prestigious hero academies.
metadata.tagline: This is the story of how we all became the greatest heroes.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: For his entire life, Izuku has dreamed of being a hero—an ambitious goal for anyone, but an especially challenging one for a boy without superpowers. That’s right: in a world where 80% of the population has some sort of special Gift, Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that won’t stop him from enrolling in one of the most prestigious hero academies in the world to learn what it truly means to be a hero.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: U.A. High School's most prestigious event begins: the Sports Festival, an opportunity for aspiring heroes to showcase their skills to both the public and potential recruiters. However, the path to glory is never easy, especially for Izuku Midoriya, who must now face off against his talented classmates to prove his worth to the world.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Summer is here and the heroes of Rooms A and B are in for the toughest training camp of their lives! A group of seasoned professionals will push the students individualities to the next level with one new challenge after another. Braving the elements of this secret location will be the least of their worries as routine training turns into a grueling fight for survival.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: With All for One out of the game, the evil world is on the brink of war. Shigaraki of the League of Villains and Overhaul of the Yakuza vie for dominance of the underworld. Meanwhile, Deku finds himself in another dangerous internship with his senior Mirio.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: Deku's next challenge, in order to become the "best hero," is a rivalry with Class 1-B, who also intend to prove that they are true heroes, with all their pride on the line! The students' morale is boosted by a direct confrontation that hasn't occurred since the sports festival. Meanwhile, a new "something" is about to awaken within Deku.

seasons.name: Season 6
seasons.overview: Along with Bakugo and Todoroki, Deku interned at the office of the No. 1 Hero, Endeavor. Working hard in an environment rich in lessons, he improved as a hero and used Black Whip, a new Quirk that was hidden within One For All.

seasons.name: Season 7
seasons.overview:
Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—the strongest woman on the planet, Star and Stripe.

However, All For One decides to intercept Star and her fleet to get his hands on her overpowered quirk before she can enter Japanese airspace. Although Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist are headed to the rendezvous point, Star makes a gamble in the present to save her comrades.

seasons.name: FINAL SEASON
seasons.overview: Deku and the heroes are plunged into a final battle against villains across Japan. Deku, by fully unleashing One For All Quirks, faces off against Shigaraki. A young and refreshed All For One faces Armored All Might, Quirkless in his powered armor suit. Will Deku be able to bring the story of how they all became the greatest heroes to its finale? Or will everything be destroyed?!

last_episode_to_air.name: My Hero Academia
last_episode_to_air.overview: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

results.original_name: セイント・ビースト〜光陰叙事詩天使譚〜
results.overview:
A long time ago, Zeus, the great god, created a three–tier hierarchy of angels, top, middle and lower, although they were supposed to be equal. Also, Zeus appointed 6 angels as Saint Beasts who govern the animals of Earth. They were: Go, the seiyu; Shin, the genbu; Rei, the suzaku; Guy, the byakko; Yuda, the kirin; and Ruka, the hooh. However, Kira, the shooting star, and Maya, the fuga, didn’t attend the selection tests and left for the Earth.

The six angels fulfilled their tasks faithfully. However, because of Zeus’s increasingly tyrannical acts, they begin to mistrust him.

The creatures confronting him are brought to life from the work of artist Taro Okamoto, such as "Sprinting Eye" and "Sulking Child". An action-packed tokusatsu tribute to one of Japan's most influential painters and sculptors!

After a near-death encounter with a pack of wolves, she then realizes that she's able to transport between two worlds—this one and her own. Taking advantage of this ability, Mitsuha decides to live in both worlds and calculates that she'll need 80,000 gold coins to be able to retire! Mitsuha now has to come up with different ways to collect her gold coins!

He loses his way in the mountains, and it starts to get dark. Seeing a big shooting star in the sky, he begins to formulate a wish, but quickly notes that something is very wrong. For the shooting star is actually a space ship about to crash into him. And then he died. Only with the help of the aliens could his live be saved. In reality, Mars is from outer space, and is supposed to gather information to decide whether Earth should be destroyed or not. Along with the giant robot Gaia, and his mysterious images of a woman urging him not to destroy the world, Mars decides to fight for Earth rather than destroy it, even if it means fighting his own kind. But if Mars is killed, Gaia will explode, destroying Earth along with it.

As the title indicates, the anime will let viewers experience ASMR in 180 seconds. In the story, the heroine challenges her classmates to share in her hobby of recording ASMR works.

results.name: Dragon Ball Super
results.original_name: ドラゴンボール超（スーパー）
results.overview: With Majin Buu defeated, Goku has taken a completely new role as...a radish farmer?! With Earth at peace, our heroes have settled into normal lives. But they can’t get too comfortable. Far away, the powerful God of Destruction, Beerus, awakens to a prophecy revealing his demise at the hands of an even more formidable being. When his search for the Saiyan God brings him to Earth, can Goku and his friends take on their strongest foe yet?

results.name: Digimon Adventure:
results.original_name: デジモンアドベンチャー：
results.overview: It's the year 2020. The Network has become something humans can no longer do without in their daily lives. But what humans don't know is that on the other side of the Network is the Digital World, a realm of light and darkness. Nor are they aware of the Digimon who live there. Fifth grader Taichi Yagami's mother and little sister Hikari went to Shibuya, and now they're aboard a runaway train. Taichi hurries to Shibuya to save his mother and sister, but the instant he heads toward the station platform... a strange phenomenon befalls the DigiDestined, and Taichi goes to the Digital World!

results.name: Talentless Nana
results.overview:
It is the year 20XX. Earth was assaulted by monsters that would come to be known as "the Enemy of Humanity." In order to deal with this threat, special schools composed of teenagers with extraordinary abilities were formed. These people, who came to be known as "the Talented," had abilities that could defy the rules of reality.

Among these people with supernatural powers was an outlier, an individual who was sent to one of these schools despite having no innate special abilities whatsoever. This is the story of our protagonist, who attempts to defeat the Enemies of Humanity through the use of intelligence and manipulation alone.

results.name: Naruto Shippūden
results.overview: After 2 and a half years Naruto finally returns to his village of Konoha, and sets about putting his ambitions to work. It will not be easy though as he has amassed a few more dangerous enemies, in the likes of the shinobi organization; Akatsuki.

results.name: Young Justice
results.overview: Teenage superheroes strive to prove themselves as members of the Justice League.

results.name: Hunter x Hunter
results.overview: Gon, a young boy who lives on Whale Island, dreams of becoming a Hunter like his father, who left when Gon was still young.

results.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX
results.original_name: 遊戯王デュエルモンスターズＧＸ
results.overview: Ten years after the Ceremonial Battle, a teenage boy named Judai Yuuki (Jaden Yuki) heads off in order to join the Duel Academia (Duel Academy) located on a remote island off the coast of Japan. There he meets his fellow students and gains a few friends, along with a few enemies. Judai is put into the lowest rank of Osiris Red (Slifer Red), but he continues to test his skills against the students and faculty to prove his worth as a Duelist and earn the respect of everyone around him.

results.name: K
results.overview: Shiro is an easygoing teenager content with just being a student—until his seemingly perfect life is halted when a bloodthirsty clan, glowing red with fire, attempts to kill him in the streets. Unbeknownst to Shiro, he is suspected of murdering a member of their clan and will need a miracle to escape their vengeance. Miraculously, a young man named Kurou Yatogami swings in and aids Shiro in his getaway, only to reveal he's also after Shiro's life. Now a hunted man, Shiro will have to evade the clans of seven powerful kings and desperately try to prove his innocence—before it’s too late!

results.name: Assassination Classroom
results.overview: The students of Class 3-E have a mission: kill their teacher before graduation. He has already destroyed the moon, and has promised to destroy the Earth if he can not be killed within a year. But how can this class of misfits kill a tentacled monster, capable of reaching Mach 20 speed, who may be the best teacher any of them have ever had?

results.name: Black Clover
results.overview: Asta and Yuno are two orphans who want the same thing: to become the Wizard King. Locked in a friendly rivalry, they work hard towards their goal. While Yuno excels at magic, Asta has a problem uncommon in this world: he has no powers! But, on the day they receive their grimoires, they surprise everyone. To reach their goal, they’ll each find their own path to greatness—with or without magic.

episodes.name: Save! Rescue Training!
episodes.overview: Four weeks after the League of Villains' attempt to assassinate All Might, the students of Class 1-A return to USJ to complete their disaster training. However, unbeknownst to the heroes-in-training, an unexpected foe is lurking within the facility's walls and waiting to strike...

episodes.name: Hero Notebook
episodes.overview: Recap of My Hero Academia's first season, aired a week before the second season.

episodes.name: Training of the Dead
episodes.overview: Story about a joint practice session between Izuku's class and Isami High students at U. A. Academy, takes place after the field training arc in the second season.

episodes.name: All Might: Rising
episodes.overview: Young All Might sees his mentor, Nana Shimura, be defeated by All For One.

episodes.name: End-Roll BBQ Picture Drama
episodes.overview: It's the day after the incident at I-Island, Deku & All Might discuss the future of David & Melissa. On the other hand, All Might's has planned a BBQ for all the members of Class 1A.

episodes.name: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training (1)
episodes.overview: UA's sophomore students are undergoing targeted training to prepare for their provisional license exams, and today they will have to take part in a rescue operation. This is just a simulation, but teamwork will be required in order to succeed in the exercise. Except that as soon as the mission begins, a landslide changes the game. The ten students who had split into several groups find themselves trapped by debris. Is this accident part of the exercise? Will the students come out of it unharmed? The survival test has just begun.

episodes.name: Make It! Do-or-Die Survival Training (2)
episodes.overview: In preparation for the provisional license exam, UA's 10th grade students are participating in a simulated rescue, but the rescue has gone wrong and the students are now trapped in an underground shopping mall. As if the situation wasn't complicated enough, water starts seeping through the walls. The students have to get out of here as soon as possible. That said, Bakugo still takes the mission very seriously and refuses to go out without finding and evacuating the rescue dummy. The water is rising dangerously. Will they be able to evacuate and avoid the disaster?

episodes.name: Heroes Rising - Epilogue Plus
episodes.overview: A picture drama epilogue to the film My Hero Academia: Heroes Rising, bundled with the BD/DVD release.

episodes.name: World Heroes' Mission - Take-off
episodes.overview: Adaptation of "No.XXX Hawks: SOOTHE" side-chapter in the Volume World Heroes manga. Included in the "Plus Ultra" version of the film's Blu-ray and DVD release in Japan.

episodes.name: HLB
episodes.overview: The "Hero League Baseball" is an organization set-up by several Pro Heroes to allow them the chance to play and compete in their spare time. For this year, the "Orcas", led by Gang Orca, and the "Lionels", led by Shishido, have made it to the finals. Present Mic narrates the game, accompanied by an extremely apathetic Eraser Head.

episodes.name: Laugh! As If You Are in Hell
episodes.overview: It's been ten months since Izuku en-rolled at U.A. High School, and on top of his regular school work, four days a week he has been continuing his Hero Work-Study at the Endeavor Agency. On one day, they are approached by a police officer, seeking assistance in tracking down a local graffiti artist vandalizing the streets.

episodes.name: U.A. Heroes Battle
episodes.overview: Class 1-A are bored out of their minds! Stuck in their dorms during the winter season, they can't go out or do anything fun. That is until third year Mirio Togata pays the students a visit with a new card game the support course developed that uses U.A. students as playable characters. Now to pass the time, they'll play this game that's just as tough as U.A. Who will win the card battle?!

episodes.name: Memories Episode 1 - Izuku Midoriya: Resolve
episodes.overview: After the Quirkless Izuku Midoriya meets All Might, he becomes the successor to All Might's Quirk, One For All, which means he must eventually go up against All For One and Tomura Shigaraki.

episodes.name: Memories Episode 2 - Toshinori Yagi: Embers
episodes.overview: All Might's last fight against All For One set off a series of events leading to his retirement as a hero, but he continues to fight, even as the embers of One For All within him die out.

episodes.name: Memories Episode 3 - Heroes: Convictions
episodes.overview: Ochaco and the Todoroki family think back about why they are fighting and reconfirm their convictions as they continue to face off against the villains.

episodes.name: Memories Episode 4 - Tomura Shigaraki: Destruction
episodes.overview: When Tomura Shigaraki was a child, a tragic accident led to the death of his family, which continues to fuel his desire to destroy.

episodes.name: A Piece of Cake
episodes.overview: Anime adaptation of special one-shot manga A Piece of Cake.

episodes.name: More
episodes.overview: Time has passed, and the former members of Class 1-A have grown up, but something is bothering Uraraka...

episodes.name: I am a hero too
episodes.overview: Eri is now a high school student with a dream of becoming a musician. Next week will be her first street performance, but when she turns to Deku, now a teacher at U.A., about it...

1.name: Season 1
1.overview: For his entire life, Izuku has dreamed of being a hero—an ambitious goal for anyone, but an especially challenging one for a boy without superpowers. That’s right: in a world where 80% of the population has some sort of special Gift, Izuku was unlucky enough to be born completely normal. But that won’t stop him from enrolling in one of the most prestigious hero academies in the world to learn what it truly means to be a hero.

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes.name: What It Takes to Be a Hero
episodes.overview: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might’s secret, but there’s trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.name: Roaring Muscles
episodes.overview: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes.name: Start Line
episodes.overview: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes.name: What I Can Do for Now
episodes.overview: It’s Izuku’s first day of high school, and he still can’t control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes.name: Rage, You Damn Nerd
episodes.overview: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might…

episodes.name: Deku vs. Kacchan
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes.name: Bakugo’s Start Line
episodes.overview: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes.name: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
episodes.overview: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes.name: Encounter with the Unknown
episodes.overview: Villains have attacked USJ, and it’s up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes.name: All Might
episodes.overview: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes.name: In Each of Our Hearts
episodes.overview: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

2.name: Season 2
2.overview: U.A. High School's most prestigious event begins: the Sports Festival, an opportunity for aspiring heroes to showcase their skills to both the public and potential recruiters. However, the path to glory is never easy, especially for Izuku Midoriya, who must now face off against his talented classmates to prove his worth to the world.

episodes.name: That’s the Idea, Ochaco
episodes.overview: As U.A. students and teachers recover from the League of Villains attack on USJ, Izuku learns about why Ochaco wants to become a hero.

episodes.name: Roaring Sports Festival
episodes.overview: The U.A. sports festival begins and all eyes are on the first-years as they start their qualifying round—the obstacle course race.

episodes.name: In Their Own Quirky Ways
episodes.overview: The first years try to stand out as they struggle to finish the obstacle course and qualify for a spot in the next round.

episodes.name: Strategy, Strategy, Strategy
episodes.overview: Izuku’s having trouble finding a team for the cavalry battle in the next round of the U.A. sports festival. Luckily, he has a plan.

episodes.name: Cavalry Battle Finale
episodes.overview: Fighting it out in the second half of the cavalry battle, does Team Midoriya have what it takes to stay in the top four?

episodes.name: The Boy Born with Everything
episodes.overview: Izuku learns more about Todoroki’s past as the first-years head into the final round of the sports festival.

episodes.name: Victory or Defeat
episodes.overview: Izuku is up against Shinso in the first match of the finals, but can he overcome Shinso’s Quirk to advance to the next round?

episodes.name: Battle on, Challengers!
episodes.overview: It’s one match after another in the first round of the finals tournament. Who will advance to second round?

episodes.name: Bakugo vs. Uraraka
episodes.overview: Bakugo seems almost villainous when he’s up against Uraraka, but she has a plan to keep it from being a one-sided match.

episodes.name: Shoto Todoroki: Origin
episodes.overview: Izuku forces Todoroki to face his past in a chilling battle as the two class rivals finally go head to head!

episodes.name: Fight On, Iida
episodes.overview: It’s class rep versus child prodigy as Iida and Todoroki square off. Will Iida’s Reciproburst be enough to beat the boy of fire and ice?

episodes.name: Todoroki vs. Bakugo
episodes.overview: The explosive showdown between Todoroki and Bakugo begins. Only one can take the title of first-year champion!

episodes.name: Time to Pick Some Names
episodes.overview: Following their epic debut at the sports festival, it’s time for the first-years to pick the most important part of their identities—their hero name!

episodes.name: Bizarre! Gran Torino Appears
episodes.overview: The internships begin! While everyone adjusts to their new tasks, Izuku starts training with Gran Torino, the same man who once taught All Might.

episodes.name: Midoriya and Shigaraki
episodes.overview: The U.A. students are finally starting to get the hang of their internships, but Izuku has much more to learn about One For All.

episodes.name: Hero Killer: Stain vs U.A. Students
episodes.overview: Stain strikes again, and this time some U.A. students are around when it happens. Will they be able to hold him off until the pros come?

episodes.name: Climax
episodes.overview: It all comes to a head as Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki face off against Stain while the pro heroes in Hosu City fight against the Nomus.

episodes.name: The Aftermath of Hero Killer: Stain
episodes.overview: Stain is finally captured, but while the hero community deals with the consequences, an even greater challenge is set in motion.

episodes.name: Everyone's Internships
episodes.overview: As Izuku, Iida, and Todoroki recover from their fight with Stain, the other members of Class 1-A work hard at their own internships.

episodes.name: Listen Up!! A Tale from the Past
episodes.overview: The students return to their daily lives while All Might has a special history lesson for Izuku. It’s time to learn about One For All!

episodes.name: Gear up for Final Exams
episodes.overview: Finals are coming up and Class 1-A is going to need more than a cram session. This year, the teachers are changing the practical exams.

episodes.name: Yaoyorozu: Rising
episodes.overview: The exams are turning out to be much more challenging than the students expected. Can any of the teams hold their own against a teacher?

episodes.name: Stripping the Varnish
episodes.overview: As the students of Class 1-A fight in their practical exams, their resolve to become heroes is put to the test.

episodes.name: Katsuki Bakugo: Origin
episodes.overview: It’s finally time for Izuku and Bakugo’s practical exam. How can they challenge All Might without a plan?

episodes.name: Encounter
episodes.overview: Class 1-A goes shopping for training camp supplies, but things get out of hand when a villain pulls Izuku aside.

3.name: Season 3
3.overview: Summer is here and the heroes of Rooms A and B are in for the toughest training camp of their lives! A group of seasoned professionals will push the students individualities to the next level with one new challenge after another. Braving the elements of this secret location will be the least of their worries as routine training turns into a grueling fight for survival.

episodes.name: Game Start
episodes.overview: Before the U.A. students head to their training camp, Class 1-A goes to the pool for extra training, and the League of Villains plots their next move.

episodes.name: Wild, Wild Pussycats
episodes.overview: Class 1-A faces the first challenge of their summer training camp when they have to fight their way through “The Beast’s Forest” before lunch.

episodes.name: Kota
episodes.overview: Izuku tries to talk with Kota as the first-years start their training in earnest. Little do they know what awaits them in the forest.

episodes.name: My Hero
episodes.overview: The villains launch their attack, and only Izuku knows where Kota is. Can he get to him in time?

episodes.name: Drive It Home, Iron Fist!!!
episodes.overview: Izuku finally makes it back to the training camp only to leave again with a message for Mandalay to broadcast.

episodes.name: Roaring Upheaval
episodes.overview: The students and teachers of U.A. are still fighting in the woods, but has the Vanguard Action Squad accomplished its mission already…?!

episodes.name: What a Twist!
episodes.overview: The battle at the training camp concludes, and now the students and teachers of U.A. have to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.name: From Iida to Midoriya
episodes.overview: Todoroki, Kirishima, and Midoriya want to go after Bakugo, but the class rep is standing in their way. Meanwhile, Shigaraki makes Bakugo an offer…

episodes.name: All For One
episodes.overview: The heroes and U.A. students close in on the League of Villains’ hideouts, but the League still has an ace up its sleeve.

episodes.name: Symbol of Peace
episodes.overview: As the fight against the League of Villains escalates, can the U.A. students get Bakugo out in time for All Might to make a big comeback?

episodes.name: One For All
episodes.overview: All Might’s time is running out as he faces his ultimate nemesis head on. Will he finally be able to defeat All For One once and for all?

episodes.name: End of the Beginning, Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: After All Might and All For One’s fight, the students go back home while the U.A. teachers decide how to deal with the aftermath.

episodes.name: Moving into Dorms
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A move into their dorms and hold a competition to determine who has the best room.

episodes.name: Create Those Ultimate Moves
episodes.overview: Class 1-A works on developing their Quirks and creating ultimate moves to prepare for the provisional hero licensing exam.

episodes.name: The Test
episodes.overview: Izuku and his classmates make some final adjustments to their ultimate moves and then head off to the provisional licensing exam.

episodes.name: Shiketsu High Lurking
episodes.overview: The exam has begun, and everyone’s after Class 1-A! Can the first-years last long enough to pass this first test?

episodes.name: Class 1-A
episodes.overview: Todoroki’s on his own against Seijin High, and Yaoyorozu’s group is pitted against Seiai Academy as they and the rest of Class 1-A fight to pass the first test.

episodes.name: RUSH!
episodes.overview: It’s down to the final minutes of the first test and almost half of Class 1-A has yet to earn a passing score!

episodes.name: Rescue Exercises
episodes.overview: The second test of the provisional licensing has begun, and the hero candidates are suddenly thrust into a rescue operation.

episodes.name: Special Episode: Save the World with Love!
episodes.overview: We take a break from the provisional licensing exam to visit a class held before the summer training camp!

episodes.name: What’s the Big Idea?
episodes.overview: The exam nears its end, but Izuku and the other hero candidates must fend off Gang Orca to finish the rescue mission.

episodes.name: A Talk about Your Quirk
episodes.overview: While the U.A. students finish up the provisional licensing exam and get their results, All Might has a talk with All For One.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Kacchan, Part 2
episodes.overview: Following the provisional licensing exam, Izuku tries out his Shoot Style on Bakugo as they have a heart-to-heart through their fight.

episodes.name: A Season for Encounters
episodes.overview: The world has changed for villains and heroes alike in the weeks after All Might’s fight with All For One, and the U.A. students start their second semester.

episodes.name: Unrivaled
episodes.overview: The students of Class 1-A learn about work studies from the Big Three. Meanwhile, the villains also prepare their next steps.

4.name: Season 4
4.overview: With All for One out of the game, the evil world is on the brink of war. Shigaraki of the League of Villains and Overhaul of the Yakuza vie for dominance of the underworld. Meanwhile, Deku finds himself in another dangerous internship with his senior Mirio.

episodes.name: The Scoop on U.A. Class 1-A
episodes.overview: After All Might announces his retirement, freelance reporter Taneo Tokuda goes to the dorms to investigate U.A. Class 1-A.

episodes.name: Overhaul
episodes.overview: Overhaul pays a visit to the League of Villains, and Midoriya tries to find a place to do his work study.

episodes.name: Boy Meets…
episodes.overview: Izuku battles Sir Nighteye so he can do his work study at Nighteye’s agency, but Nighteye has someone else in mind to be All Might’s successor…

episodes.name: Fighting Fate
episodes.overview: Izuku’s mind is swirling with feelings from his work study, so he goes and talks to All Might about it and learns about All Might’s fate.

episodes.name: Let’s Go, Gutsy Red Riot
episodes.overview: The U.A. work study students go out with their respective heroes and become involved in some big fights.

episodes.name: An Unpleasant Talk
episodes.overview: The work study students from U.A. attend a meeting of heroes gathered by Sir Nighteye and leave with new resolve.

episodes.name: GO!!
episodes.overview: The work study students wait until the pro heroes find Eri and it’s time to start the operation to save her.

episodes.name: Suneater of the Big Three
episodes.overview: The Shie Hassaikai is going all out to stop the heroes, and Suneater volunteers to take out the first batch of Eight Bullets members in their way.

episodes.name: Red Riot
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai continues, Kirishima has to face his past when he and Fat Gum get separated from the others.

episodes.name: Temp Squad
episodes.overview: The Hassaikai gets some help from the League of Villains as the heroes continue to make their way to Chisaki to rescue Eri.

episodes.name: Lemillion
episodes.overview: The League of Villains stay true to their name in their fight. Meanwhile, Togata catches up to Chisaki and Eri first…

episodes.name: Unforeseen Hope
episodes.overview: Izuku, Eraser Head, and Sir Nighteye finally reach the area where Chisaki and the others are and find Togata past his limit…

episodes.name: Infinite 100%
episodes.overview: As the fight with the Shie Hassaikai reaches its climax, Chisaki looks back on how it all started, and Izuku uses All For One at 100%.

episodes.name: Bright Future
episodes.overview: As the heroes deal with the aftermath of the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, the vehicle transporting Chisaki has an encounter with the League of Villains…

episodes.name: Smoldering Flames
episodes.overview: After the fight with the Shie Hassaikai, a new villain emerges, and the students who participated reflect on their own roles as future heroes.

episodes.name: Win Those Kids’ Hearts
episodes.overview: Camie joins the provisional license training course and is added to the team working with the kids from Masegaki. Meanwhile, Endeavor has a serious talk with All Might.

episodes.name: Relief for License Trainees
episodes.overview: The trainees bond with the precocious Masegaki kids and life at U.A. goes back to normal as autumn approaches, but Aoyama has been acting strangely…

episodes.name: School Festival
episodes.overview: As the students of U.A. prepare for their school festival, Deku and Togata visit Eri in the hospital. Meanwhile, a new villain named Gentle Criminal begins his reign of crime.

episodes.name: Prepping for the School Festival Is the Most Fun Part
episodes.overview: Class 1-A assigns roles for their performance at the school festival, and Gentle starts preparing his next plan.

episodes.name: Gold Tips Imperial
episodes.overview: Eri visits U.A. while the students are preparing for the school festival, and Gentle finalizes his plans.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Gentle Criminal
episodes.overview: As Deku buys some last-minute supplies for the school festival, he encounters a mysterious man wrapped in a trench coat…

episodes.name: School Festival Start!!
episodes.overview: Izuku must stop Gentle Criminal and his partner, La Brava, or else the school festival will be cancelled.

episodes.name: Let It Flow! School Festival!
episodes.overview: Izuku rushes back to the school festival after his encounter with Gentleman and La Brava, but will he make it in time for his performance?

episodes.name: Japanese Hero Billboard Chart
episodes.overview: It’s time for the next Japanese Hero Billboard Chart rankings to be announced, and this time, all the top ten heroes make an appearance.

episodes.name: His Start
episodes.overview: Endeavor and Hawks are up against High-End, and it’s Endeavor’s chance to show the world what the new number one hero is like.

5.name: Season 5
5.overview: Deku's next challenge, in order to become the "best hero," is a rivalry with Class 1-B, who also intend to prove that they are true heroes, with all their pride on the line! The students' morale is boosted by a direct confrontation that hasn't occurred since the sports festival. Meanwhile, a new "something" is about to awaken within Deku.

episodes.name: All Hands on Deck! Class 1-A
episodes.overview: There's an emergency drill at U.A. High School, and Class 1-A is requested to report for duty!

episodes.name: Vestiges
episodes.overview: After their fight with the Nomu, Hawks and Endeavor return to daily life, and Izuku dreams of One For All…

episodes.name: Clash! Class A vs. Class B!
episodes.overview: Class A and Class B are joined by a special guest as they battle it out during their joint combat training.

episodes.name: Make It Happen, Shinso!
episodes.overview: The Class A team tries to put Shinso and his new equipment to good use in the first match against Class B.

episodes.name: Operation New Improv Moves
episodes.overview: It's darkness versus darkness as Tokoyami and Kuroiro face off in the second match of the class battles!

episodes.name: Foresight
episodes.overview: Separated from her team, Yaoyorozu's leadership skills are put to the test in the second match of the class battles.

episodes.name: Match 3
episodes.overview: In the third match of the class battles, Honenuki leads the Class B team against a well-balanced Class A team.

episodes.name: Match 3 Conclusion
episodes.overview: It's still anybody's game as the the third match continues with an endurance battle between Todoroki and Tetsutetsu.

episodes.name: Early Bird!
episodes.overview: Bakugo shows a different side of himself in the fourth team match as the class battles continue.

episodes.name: That Which Is Inherited
episodes.overview: Midoriya and Shinso face off for the first time since the sports festival in the last fight of the class battles.

episodes.name: Our Brawl
episodes.overview: It's an all-out brawl as the last two teams from Class A and Class B fight it out to the finish!

episodes.name: The New Power and All For One
episodes.overview: As the class battles conclude, Midoriya works with All Might and Bakugo on learning more about his new power.

episodes.name: Have a Merry Christmas!
episodes.overview: It's Christmas at U.A. and the Class 1-A students celebrate with a Christmas party.

episodes.name: Off to Endeavor's Agency!
episodes.overview: Hawks acts strange when he meets Endeavor and his work study students on their way to Endeavor Agency.

episodes.name: One Thing at a Time
episodes.overview: As the villains continue to move behind the scenes, Endeavor helps his work study students with the next steps in their training.

episodes.name: Long Time No See, Selkie
episodes.overview: Ryukyu brings her work study students with her when Selkie asks her to team up with him.

episodes.name: The Hellish Todoroki Family
episodes.overview: Endeavor brings his work study students over for dinner at Fuyumi's request but faces awkward conversations at home.

episodes.name: The Unforgiven
episodes.overview: One of Endeavor's biggest fans shows up to settle some unfinished business, and he expects far more than an autograph.

episodes.name: More of a Hero Than Anyone
episodes.overview: When an unsettling discovery is made regarding Kurogiri, Aizawa and Present Mic are summoned to interrogate him.

episodes.name: My Villain Academia
episodes.overview: A series of surprise encounters helps give Shigaraki a new sense of direction for the League of Villains.

episodes.name: Revival Party
episodes.overview: The League of Villains waits for Gigantomachia to wake up as they clash with the Meta Liberation Army.

episodes.name: Sad Man's Parade
episodes.overview: As Twice tries to save Toga, he thinks back on his past and makes a realization that helps him overcome it.

episodes.name: Tenko Shimura: Origin
episodes.overview: Memories from Shigaraki's past as Tenko Shimura resurface as he confronts Re-Destro.

episodes.name: Tomura Shigaraki: Origin
episodes.overview: Shigaraki remembers his first encounter with All For One during the climax of his battle with Re-Destro.

episodes.name: The High, Deep Blue Sky
episodes.overview: Both sides prepare for the confrontation between the heroes and the Paranormal Liberation Front as Class 1-A finishes their first year of high school.

6.name: Season 6
6.overview: Along with Bakugo and Todoroki, Deku interned at the office of the No. 1 Hero, Endeavor. Working hard in an environment rich in lessons, he improved as a hero and used Black Whip, a new Quirk that was hidden within One For All.

episodes.name: A Quiet Beginning
episodes.overview: Using the information Hawks gathered, the heroes and their work study students get ready for an attack on the Paranormal Liberation Front led by Shigaraki.

episodes.name: Mirko, the No. 5 Hero
episodes.overview: As Endeavor and the others fight the Nomus at the hospital, Mirko goes against Kyudai Garaki's best soldiers, the High-Ends. Meanwhile, Kaminari steels his resolve to save those he cares about and goes to the front line of team Edgeshot.

episodes.name: One's Justice
episodes.overview: Inside Gunga Villa, the Paranormal Liberation Front realizes that they are under attack, and Twice confronts Hawks about his betrayal.

episodes.name: Inheritance
episodes.overview: An enraged Dabi confronts Hawks after Twice's death, meanwhile at the Hospital Endeavor, Eraser head, Crust, Present Mic and X-less finally arrive to help Mirko, who's risking her life to stop Shigaraki's awakening.

episodes.name: The Thrill of Destruction
episodes.overview: The fight against the High-End Nomus in Jaku Hospital continues however they are unaware that Tomura Shigaraki has awakened. Whilst this is happening, Tokoyami flies in to try and save Hawks from Dabi.

episodes.name: Encounter, Part 2
episodes.overview: Gigantomachia and the rest of the Paranormal Liberation Front gain the upper hand at the Gunga Mountain Villa as the newly awakened Tomura Shigaraki finds a new objective; steal One for All from Izuku Midoriya.

episodes.name: Disaster Walker
episodes.overview: The fight against Shigaraki continues while other heroes fight the new Nomus that Shigaraki summoned. While this is happening Team Edgeshot tries to stop Gigantomachia from making it to Jaku City.

episodes.name: League of Villains vs. U.A. Students
episodes.overview: The pro heroes' defensive net was broken through. Facing the monstrous giant are the U.A. hero course students. Class A and Class B work together to start a big operation to block Gigantomachia.

episodes.name: Katsuki Bakugo: Rising
episodes.overview: As Aizawa seems to be out of the battle, Midoriya tries to keep Shigaraki in the air utilizing all of his quirks. Knowing his limit is near, Bakugo comes up with a plan to help him.

episodes.name: The Ones Within Us
episodes.overview: Shigaraki's attack pierced right through Kacchan. Deku loses himself to his rage and thrust himself to Shigaraki. However, things change suddenly. In the world of One For All, Deku stand against Shigaraki and All For One.

episodes.name: Dabi's Dance
episodes.overview: As Ochaco and Toga exchange words and blows, Gigantomachia reaches Shigaraki and the heroes, and Dabi reveals the secret of his past.

episodes.name: Threads of Hope
episodes.overview: Best Jeanist appears and spins together the hopes of all the heroes in this fight as the climax of the all-out war draws near.

episodes.name: Final Performance
episodes.overview: Thinking of his great-great-grandfather, Mr. Compress performs his greatest trick in order to save the League of Villains.

episodes.name: Hellish Hell
episodes.overview: The heroes wrestle with changing public opinion as they deal with the aftermath of the fierce battle and mourn those they lost in the fight.

episodes.name: Tartarus
episodes.overview: Under All For One's control, Shigaraki attacks Tartarus with the Nomus to free All For One's body, freeing many other prisoners in the process.

episodes.name: The Hellish Todoroki Family, Part 2
episodes.overview: As heroes deal with criticism from the public, Hawks thinks back on his past with his family, and Endeavor's family visits him in the hospital.

episodes.name: The Wrong Way to Put Out a Fire
episodes.overview: Endeavor and his family reflect on Toya's past and the events that led to his death, and Hawks and Best Jeanist bring them a proposition.

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya and Tomura Shigaraki
episodes.overview: Inside One For All, Izuku talks with the past wielders as the top three heroes deal with public sentiment after Dabi's revelation.

episodes.name: Full Power!!
episodes.overview: After Izuku decides not to go back to U.A., he finds himself facing Muscular, who was broken out of jail, again and uses the Quirks of the past wielders against him.

episodes.name: Hired Gun
episodes.overview: The top three heroes continue to face criticism as they deal with jailbreakers and look for hints about All For One and Shigaraki's whereabouts, and Izuku comes across a villain from Tartarus.

episodes.name: The Lovely Lady Nagant
episodes.overview: During Izuku's fight with Lady Nagant, she tells him secrets about hero society that further solidify his resolve to help those who need his help.

episodes.name: Friend
episodes.overview: As Izuku goes off alone in his quest for justice, his classmates realize something is wrong and try to find a way to help him.

episodes.name: Deku vs. Class A
episodes.overview: As Deku tries to run away, Class A draws him back by recounting their memories with him and reminding him of his own words.

episodes.name: A Young Woman's Declaration
episodes.overview: As the evacuees at U.A. voice their dissent, Ochaco speaks up to try and sway them. Onlookers with ties to Izuku try to figure out if it's time for them to speak out, too.

episodes.name: No Man Is an Island
episodes.overview: As Izuku tries to rest and recover back at U.A. with his classmates, All Might has an encounter with Stain that leads to new information about Shigaraki and All For One.

7.name: Season 7
7.overview:
Following an all-out battle with the Paranormal Liberation Front, it is difficult for the people of Japan to continue placing faith in their heroes. To combat the combined power of Tomura Shigaraki and All For One, All Might calls for his ally from the West—the strongest woman on the planet, Star and Stripe.

However, All For One decides to intercept Star and her fleet to get his hands on her overpowered quirk before she can enter Japanese airspace. Although Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist are headed to the rendezvous point, Star makes a gamble in the present to save her comrades.

episodes.name: In the Nick of Time! A Big-Time Maverick from the West
episodes.overview: As jailbreakers run rampant in Japan, Star and Stripe flies from the U.S. to Japan to help and finds Shigaraki waiting for her in the middle of her flight path.

episodes.name: Specter
episodes.overview: The fight between Star and Stripe and Shigaraki is coming to an end, but Star has one more trick up her sleeve with New Order.

episodes.name: Villain
episodes.overview: After failing to steal Star's Quirk, New Order, and losing many other Quirks, Shigaraki and All For One prepare for their next move. Who is the traitor at U.A.?!

episodes.name: The Story of How We All Became Heroes
episodes.overview: Due to his relationship with All For One, Yuga Aoyama calls himself a villain, but Deku tells him that he can still be a hero and reaches a hand out to him.

episodes.name: Let You Down
episodes.overview: As heroes and villains get ready for the coming battle, Deku and the others leave U.A., and Deku is called out by Aoyama, who is supposed to be in a police cell. What does Aoyama want?

episodes.name: Division
episodes.overview: It's finally time for the decisive battle between heroes and villains! The plan by All Might, Aizawa, and the others has them start their fights in various places around Japan!

episodes.name: Inflation
episodes.overview: Even though Shigaraki's Quirks are sealed, he attacks Bakugo and the others with a strange new appearance and power. Meanwhile, Deku is pulled to where Toga was warped and Todoroki and Dabi face off!

episodes.name: Two Flashfires
episodes.overview: Eleven years ago, Toya Todoroki was burned by his own flames and became Dabi. Todoroki faces Dabi's blue flames with a new move of his own. Will he be able to stop his brother?

episodes.name: Extras
episodes.overview: Shoto Todoroki stopped Dabi with his Great Glacial Aegir, and reports of that bolstered the spirits of the heroes fighting in other locations. And Shoto and Dabi's father, Endeavor, is facing the greatest evil, All For One, with Hawks!

episodes.name: Wounded Hero, Burning Bright and True!!
episodes.overview: Before the threat of All For One, Endeavor falls, and Hawks, Jiro, and Tokoyami are also cornered. Even so, Jiro acts like a hero! Endeavor is also encouraged after looking back at his own life.

episodes.name: Light Fades to Rain
episodes.overview: Bakugo's Howitzer Impact didn't work against Shigaraki/All For One, either, and Bakugo is pushed into a corner by Shigaraki's power and words. In order to get him out of that predicament, U.A.'s Big Three take a stand!

episodes.name: Those Who Defend, Those Who Violate
episodes.overview: Bakugo surprised Shigaraki/All For One with Cluster but was then cruelly pierced through. The heroes in all the different locations are getting pushed back... But even so, they will not give up!

episodes.name: A Chain of Events, Across the Ages
episodes.overview: Deku finally arrives at the Coffin in the Sky! Seeing Bakugo and the others defeated by Shigaraki/All For One, Deku shakes with anger. Can he control his feelings and win against Shigaraki? It's finally time for a showdown!

episodes.name: Together with Shoji
episodes.overview: Spinner takes heteromorphs who are exploding with resentment from being persecuted to Central Hospital to get Kurogiri back. Shoji, whose Quirk also makes him a heteromorph, shouts his feelings to them.

episodes.name: Butterfly Effect
episodes.overview: Spinner and Present Mic both yell their hearts out. Will the one waking up to their voices be Kurogiri, or Shirakumo? Meanwhile, fighting Ochaco and the others on Okuto Island, Toga is finally going to use her secret weapon...!

episodes.name: The Chain Thus Far
episodes.overview: Toga consumed Twice's blood, and with Kurogiri's Warp, infinite doubles of Twice appear. Shigaraki's Decay is also released, and the heroes seem to be in a state of despair. But then, help comes from an unexpected quarter...

episodes.name: Hopes
episodes.overview: With the addition of Gentle, La Brava, and Lady Nagant, Deku is able to restrain Shigaraki's hands and confront him on the ground. Meanwhile, at the Gunga Villa site, the rewound All For One shows off his awful power...

episodes.name: It's a Small World
episodes.overview: Shishikura and the other members of Shiketsu High join the fight at the Gunga Villa site, and it's do-or-die as the heroes unite to fight back! But as All For One gets younger, he gets stronger. That's when unexpected backup arrives...!

episodes.name: I Am Here
episodes.overview: Trampling the heroes, All For One flies to become one with Shigaraki, and Dabi is about to explode with the heat he's been storing up in his body. Will the Symbol be able change this hopeless situation?

episodes.name: A Girl's Ego
episodes.overview: Toga transforms into Twice and backs the heroes into a corner with Infinite Doubles. In the midst of that, Ochaco does her best to get close to Toga to talk to her. How does Toga respond...?

episodes.name: Battle Without a Quirk
episodes.overview: Toga returns the smile of Ochaco, who tried to be friends with her. What does Toga do to the seriously-injured Ochaco? Meanwhile, All Might uses "power" developed by a friend to face All For One!

8.name: FINAL SEASON
8.overview: Deku and the heroes are plunged into a final battle against villains across Japan. Deku, by fully unleashing One For All Quirks, faces off against Shigaraki. A young and refreshed All For One faces Armored All Might, Quirkless in his powered armor suit. Will Deku be able to bring the story of how they all became the greatest heroes to its finale? Or will everything be destroyed?!

episodes.name: Toshinori Yagi: Rising/Origin
episodes.overview: The fierce battle continues between Armored All Might and All For One. Can All Might possibly win?

episodes.name: The End of an Era, and the Beginning
episodes.overview: All Might receives help from an unexpected source when Stain joins him in the battle against All For One.

episodes.name: The Final Boss!!
episodes.overview: Bakugo is back on his feet! Can he rescue All Might from All For One, and defeat the villain in battle?

episodes.name: Quirk: Explosion!!
episodes.overview: The fierce battle with Bakugo reminds All For One of his and his brother Yoichi's origins.

episodes.name: History's Greatest Villain
episodes.overview: The balance of power shifts between Izuku and Shigaraki when the latter steals a Quirk from One For All.

episodes.name: Wrench It Open, Izuku Midoriya!!
episodes.overview: Izuku attempts to forcefully transfer One For All to Shigaraki, as this might prove to be the key to victory.

episodes.name: From Aizawa
episodes.overview: Izuku dives deep into Shigaraki's mind, in search of the villain's origin: the tragic Tenko Shimura.

episodes.name: Izuku Midoriya: Rising
episodes.overview: After All For One takes over Shigaraki's body, the heroes must fight as one big team to defeat him.

episodes.name: Epilogue, The Hellish Todoroki Family: Final
episodes.overview: With the long conflict over at last, the time has come to rebuild. Both on a societal and personal level.

episodes.name: The Girl Who Loves Smiles
episodes.overview: The struggle against the villains may be over, but Izuku and Ochaco both still have internal demons to face.

episodes.name: My Hero Academia
episodes.overview: How has the world changed in the eight years since Izuku and the heroes defeated All For One and Shigaraki?

items.title: The Originals
items.overview: The Vampire Diaries spin-off that follows the Mikaelsons, a family of millennia-old, power-hungry vampires who want to reclaim the city they built, New Orleans, and dominate all those who have wronged them.

metadata.name: The Originals
metadata.overview: The Vampire Diaries spin-off that follows the Mikaelsons, a family of millennia-old, power-hungry vampires who want to reclaim the city they built, New Orleans, and dominate all those who have wronged them.
metadata.tagline: Always and forever.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Family is power. The Original Vampire family swore it to each other a thousand years ago. They pledged to remain together, always and forever. Now, centuries have passed and the bonds of family are broken. Time, tragedy and hunger for power have torn the Original Family apart. When Klaus Mikaelson, the original vampire-werewolf hybrid, receives a mysterious tip that a plot is brewing against him in the supernatural melting pot that is the French Quarter of New Orleans, he returns to the city his family helped build. Klaus’ questions lead him to a reunion with his diabolical former protégé, Marcel, a charismatic vampire who has total control over the human and supernatural inhabitants of New Orleans.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, a new status quo must be adjusted to, as the newly empowered werewolves control the city. Plus, Klaus struggles with weaknesses and Elijah fights to save Hayley — now a hybrid — from a vicious spiral of self-destruction.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Season three finds Klaus and Elijah estranged from each other, even as both brothers adjust to life with their long-lost sister, Freya. Hayley suffers mightily at the hands of Klaus’s petty vengeance, while Marcel and Davina rule the city under a new status quo. Meanwhile, Cami and Vincent find themselves caught up in a surprising mystery involving the newest resident of New Orleans.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: When a dark prophecy threatens their immortal lives, the Mikaelson family faces their greatest challenge yet. After centuries of fighting to preserve their family, Klaus Mikaelson and his brother Elijah’s ruthless actions have spawned a legion of enemies. Surrounded by these enemies, the Mikaelsons enact a brutal strategy that will turn everyone against them, thus setting the course for season four.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The age old Mikaelson family has spent centuries fighting against legions of enemies. The original vampires have strived since the beginning of time to protect their family, no matter what the cost. The fifth and final season is no different as the Mikaelsons must once again count on the strength of their unbreakable family bond even after swearing to stay away from each other for good.

last_episode_to_air.name: When the Saints Go Marching In
last_episode_to_air.overview: Intent on saving Hope's life, Klaus' plan will change the lives of the Mikaelson family forever.

results.overview: Elena Micheals thought she left the world of supernatural behind when she left Stonehaven behind 'for good this time' she thought. Until the night she got the mysterious call from her pack leader asking her to come back. So now she is heading back, leaving her life as a normal photographer in Toronto for the moment to re-enter the world of werewolves, rules about protect the pack and a man she has spent years trying to get out of her system. Oh and did she mention she was the only living female werewolf in existence?
results.name: Bitten

results.overview: The adventures of Joanna Beauchamp and her two adult daughters Freya and Ingrid -- both of whom unknowingly are their family's next generation of witches -- who lead seemingly quiet, uneventful modern day lives in Long Island's secluded seaside town of East Haven. When Freya becomes engaged to a young, wealthy newcomer, a series of events forces Joanna to admit to her daughters they are, in fact, powerful and immortal witches.
results.name: Witches of East End

results.original_name: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
results.overview: The horror and crime thriller genres collide in this new original series from Robert Rodriguez, based on his cult grindhouse classic about bank-robbing brothers on the run, a lawman bent on bringing them to justice, the devout family caught in the cross-fire, and an ancient evil eager to feast on them all.
results.name: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

results.overview:
The Big Easy television series was inspired by the film of the same name from 1987. The show premiered on the USA Cable Network August 11, 1996. Tony Crane played New Orleans police lieutenant/detective Remy McSwain, Susan Walters played state district attorney Anne Osbourne and Barry Corbin played police chief C.D. LeBlanc. Daniel Petrie Jr. was the executive producer of the series. 35 episodes were broadcast over two seasons.

The series takes place in New Orleans, Louisiana and was shot on location.
results.name: The Big Easy

results.overview: Follows the staff and patients of a Yorkshire cottage hospital in the 60s, embroiled in tangled love lives and bitter power struggles.
results.name: The Royal

results.overview: Three sisters (Prue, Piper and Phoebe) reunite and unlock their powers to become the Charmed Ones, the most powerful good witches of all time, whose prophesied destiny is to protect innocent lives from evil beings such as demons and warlocks. Each sister possesses unique magical powers that grow and evolve, while they attempt to maintain normal lives in modern day San Francisco.
results.name: Charmed

results.overview: Pinky and Brain are genetically enhanced laboratory mice who reside in a cage in the Acme Labs research facility. Brain is self-centered and scheming; Pinky is good-natured but feebleminded. In each episode, Brain devises a new plan to take over the world, which ultimately ends in failure, usually due to Pinky's idiocy, the impossibility of Brain's plan, Brain's own arrogance, or just circumstances beyond their control.
results.name: Pinky and the Brain

results.overview: Micki and Ryan with the help of their friend Jack try to recover cursed antiques so they can store them in safety inside the antique store's vault.
results.name: Friday the 13th: The Series

results.overview: The series follows 14-year-old Emma Alonso, as she moves to Miami and her life turns upside-down. Not only does she discover that she is a witch, she also has a crush on the boy next door, Daniel. But Daniel’s ex-girlfriend Maddie, who is an 'evil witch' and leader of the school clique the 'Panthers', is still willing to fight for the boy she loves.
results.name: Every Witch Way

results.overview: Rion, a naive, loudmouthed teenager, investigates a host club full of vampires when she suspects they must be related to the disappearance of a lot of people in the neighborhood, including her best friend. In the process she begins to befriend them, especially the leader Suou, with whom she develops a romantic relationship.
results.name: Vampire Host

results.original_name: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険
results.overview: Jotaro Kujo is a popular high school student – at least until that day when he thinks he is possessed by a ghost, which is why he locks himself up. During a fight between his grandfather and his grandfather’s friend Muhammad Abdul, he notices that the ghost is his “Stand”, named "Star Platinium", his fighting aura. Later, his mother also gets such a “Stand” and thus falls ill. Jotaro learns that a man named Dio Brando, who was defeated by Jotaro’s great-great-grandfather a hundred years ago, is to blame. He joins his grandfather and Abdul to destroy Dio once and for all.
results.name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure

results.overview: Rancho da Maromba is the vacation destination for Luiza, Dado, Mocotó, Juli and the gym class, who travel to the colony in the forests in search of adventure, nature and fun.
results.name: Malhação de Verão

results.overview: Jinkies! This raucous reimagining of the Scooby-Doo franchise unravels the mysterious origins of Mystery, Inc. – as seen through the eyes of the gang’s beloved bespectacled detective Velma.
results.name: Velma

results.overview: Set in the volatile world of 17th century Massachusetts, 'Salem' explores what really fueled the town's infamous witch trials and dares to uncover the dark, supernatural truth hiding behind the veil of this infamous period in American history. In Salem, witches are real, but they are not who or what they seem.
results.name: Salem

results.overview: Guideau is a young woman who was cursed by a witch, forced to carry a dark secret. Ashaf is a tall, soft-spoken man with a coffin strapped to his back and secrets yet untold. Together they venture across the land on their quest for vengeance. Appearances can be deceiving, and each step could be their last. In a dark fantasy filled with adventure, will unlikely heroes find the vengeance they seek?
results.name: The Witch and the Beast
True Blood
results.overview: Thanks to a Japanese scientist's invention of synthetic blood, vampires have progressed overnight from legendary monsters to fellow citizens. And while humans have been safely removed from the menu, many remain apprehensive about these creatures "coming out of the coffin." Religious leaders, government officials, and vampire fundamentalists around the world have chosen their sides.  But in the small Louisiana town of Bon Temps, the jury is still out.

results.name: Locke & Key
results.overview: After their dad's murder, three siblings move with their mom to his ancestral estate, where they discover magical keys that unlock powers — and secrets.

results.name: Angel
results.overview: The vampire Angel, cursed with a soul, moves to Los Angeles and aids people with supernatural-related problems while questing for his own redemption. A spin-off from Buffy the Vampire Slayer.

results.name: Chilling Adventures of Sabrina
results.overview: Magic and mischief collide as half-human, half-witch Sabrina navigates between two worlds: mortal teen life and her family's legacy, the Church of Night.

results.name: The Strain
results.overview: A high concept thriller that tells the story of Dr. Ephraim Goodweather, the head of the Center for Disease Control Canary Team in New York City. He and his team are called upon to investigate a mysterious viral outbreak with hallmarks of an ancient and evil strain of vampirism. As the strain spreads, Eph, his team, and an assembly of everyday New Yorkers, wage war for the fate of humanity itself.

results.name: Legacies
results.overview: In a place where young witches, vampires, and werewolves are nurtured to be their best selves in spite of their worst impulses, Klaus Mikaelson’s daughter, 17-year-old Hope Mikaelson, Alaric Saltzman’s twins, Lizzie and Josie Saltzman, among others, come of age into heroes and villains at The Salvatore School for the Young and Gifted.

results.name: American Horror Stories
results.overview: An anthology series of stand alone episodes delving into horror myths, legends and lore.

results.name: Interview with the Vampire
results.overview: A century-old vampire from New Orleans reunites with an ailing journalist to recount his life of bloodlust and his tumultuous relationship with the rakish Frenchman who turned him.

results.name: Motherland: Fort Salem
results.overview: Set in an alternate America where witches ended their persecution over 300 years ago by cutting a deal with the government to fight for their country, the series follows three young women from basic training in combat magic into early deployment.

results.name: Midnight, Texas
results.overview: Welcome to a place where being normal is really quite strange. In a remote Texas town no one is who they seem. From vampires and witches to psychics and hit men, Midnight is a mysterious safe haven for those who are different. As the town members fight off outside pressures from rowdy biker gangs, ever-suspicious cops and their own dangerous pasts, they band together and form a strong and unlikely family.

results.name: Preacher
results.overview: A preacher sets out on a mission to make the almighty himself confess his sin of abandoning the world. With his best friend Cassidy, an alcoholic Irish vampire, his love Tulip, a red blooded gun towing Texan, and the power of genesis, an unholy child born from an angel and a devil, Jesse gives up everything to set the world straight with its creator.

results.name: Being Human
results.overview: Three paranormal roommates, a ghost, a vampire, and a werewolf, struggle to keep their dark secrets from the world, while helping each other navigate the complexities of living double lives.

results.name: The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon
results.overview: After washing ashore in France, Daryl struggles to piece together how he got there and why, as he navigates a fractured, walker-infested landscape to find his way home. During his journey, Daryl has to protect a young boy, Laurent, who is seen as a messiah, while facing new, dangerous walker variants and the "Power of the Living" paramilitary group, as the connections he forms along the way complicate his plan to return home.

results.name: Van Helsing
results.overview: Vanessa Helsing, the daughter of famous vampire hunter and Dracula nemesis Abraham Van Helsing is resurrected five years in the future to find out that vampires have taken over the world and that she possesses unique power over them. She is humanity’s last hope to lead an offensive to take back what has been lost.

results.name: Tru Calling
results.overview: A university graduate working in the city morgue is able to repeat the same day over again to prevent murders or other disasters.

episodes.name: Pilot (Director's Cut)
episodes.overview: The Originals backdoor pilot episode originally aired as an episode of The Vampire Diaries season 4, titled "The Originals" (S04E20). A similar but somewhat altered and re-cut version of this episode is known as the Director's Cut, which premiered at San Diego Comic-Con in July 2013. While the bulk of the episode remained the same as what was already seen in The Vampire Diaries, some new scenes had been added, while others had been cut. Amongst the changes are the introduction of Davina (Danielle Campbell), the only major character who did not appear at all in “The Originals” episode. This Director's Cut Pilot is different again from what will air when the show premieres in the fall. The first episode in Oct 2013 is set to continue chronologically from what the Vampire Diaries (and also from this Directors Cut) have already introduced.

episodes.name: Sneak Peak: Who Wants to Be Tortured?
The Awakening: Part 1
